svg.title: Figure 2. Dose trajectories of four endpoints
svg.desc: Slug-level values and equal-weight slug medians across nine evaluation points. Only d0 versus d192 is the primary contrast.
svg.text: Dose trajectories reveal different failure modes
Small dots are 16 slug values; colored lines are equal-weight slug medians. Intermediate doses are descriptive.
Primary contrast: d0 versus d192. The curves do not establish a causal dose effect.
